source.title: Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5 ("Castlederg Union"); Derry Journal, 25 April 1930, p. 7 ("Castlederg Union nominations")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: read on the block image of the Ulster Herald's 'Castlederg Union' (26 April 1930, p. 5, article ULH19300426.2.78) and checked against the Derry Journal of 25 April 1930, p. 7: 'Mr. R. A. Scott, Clerk of Castlederg Union, has received the following nominations, and all the candidates are returned unopposed'

note: Triennial election of the Castlederg rural district councillors, 1930. One nomination was received for each of the sixteen divisions 'and all the candidates are returned unopposed' (Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5; Derry Journal, 25 April 1930, p. 7). No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 4 June 1930. Returned unopposed.
